name: Shiki Yorimichi
source: Yorimichi, the heir to the esteemed House Shiki and father of Kyouko, is a man of unwavering discipline. A man of few words, he holds himself and those around him to exacting standards.  His dedication is reflected in his mastery of both the arts of literature and combat, showcasing his quiet intensity and strength.
